memory:
Lives in Harajuku’s new studio for 3 months; convenient commute. Enjoys Tokyo fall foliage, beer, exploring hidden gems; found a Daikanyama coffee shop. Plans public-transit Yokohama day trip: Minato Mirai 21, Red Brick Warehouse, seafood (kanimeshi, namashirasu, grilled squid), autumn events/illumi
